Black—Victini and Reshiram| enva=[[Eileen Stevens]]| java=[[Shōko Nakagawa]]| }} '''Luis''' (Japanese: '''オード''' ''Aude'') is a minor supporting character who appeared in [[M14|''White—Victini and Zekrom'' and ''Black—Victini and Reshiram'']]. He is a young boy currently living in a frozen region and a descendant of the "[[Kingdom of the Vale|People of the Vale]]". ==In the movies== In the beginning of ''Black—Victini and Reshiram'', Luis was out on the frozen tundra with his mother, village leader [[Glacine]], searching for [[Revival Herb]]s. His {{p|Lillipup}} had just found some under the ice when a giant iceberg crashed into the glacier he and his mother were on. Both ran for cover and they were almost rescued by the arrival of [[Donuke]]. However, his sled was flipped over by a {{p|Beartic}} and the three were trapped on a crumbling sheet of ice, with the iceberg still incoming. They were saved by [[Damon]], who summoned {{OBP|Zekrom|M14}} to destroy the iceberg with {{m|Fusion Bolt}}. He was also seen in a flashback of Damon's in ''White—Victini and Reshiram'', where he gives Damon a bottle of Revival Herb potion. Luis was later seen in both movies with Glacine and Donuke, as well as the people of the desert village, who all came to [[Eindoak Town]] to show their support for Damon's idea. He was also seen in the ending credits with [[Luisa]]. ===Pokémon=== {{MissingInfo|1|enva}} {{TrainerPoké |main=no |trainer=Luis |pkmn=Lillipup |type1=Normal |img=Luis Lillipup.png |epnum=M14 |epname=Black—Victini and Reshiram |vajp=Minako Kotobuki |desc={{p|Lillipup}} appears as Luis's Pokémon at his home in the frozen region. It helps him search for rare herbs frozen in the ice. Later on, it nearly falls into the icy water after Luis loses his grip on it when a giant iceberg hits the glacier. Fortunately, it is saved by Damon's {{p|Gothitelle}}'s {{m|Confusion}}. None of Lillipup's moves are known. }} ===Voice actors=== {{vatable|color={{black color light}}|bordercolor={{black color}} |ja=中川翔子 ''[[Shōko Nakagawa]]'' |en=[[Eileen Stevens]] |da=Samuel Scharbau Bald |fi=Susa Saukko |pt_br=Matheus Ferreira |es_la=Fernando Calderón |es_eu=Blanca Hualde |pl=Franciszek Dziduch}} ==In the manga== ===Movie adaptations=== Luis appears in a single panel of ''{{ma|White—Victini and Zekrom}}'', where he is seen in the flashback of Damon visiting the tundra village on a journey to gather the descendants of the People of the Vale. Luis does not travel to Eindoak Town in support of Damon's plan as he does in the movie. ==Trivia== * His Japanese name may be based on {{wp|Aude}}, a department in France.
